summary: This directory defines the core service interfaces, input parameters, and response structures required to interact with AI model providers, establishing a standard contract for text generation, object creation, streaming, and embedding operations.
responsibilities: Defining standard interfaces for AI model service interactions
Standardizing parameters for generating text, objects, and embeddings
Defining the structure of AI responses and streaming events
Providing service tags for dependency injection of AI provider services
relationships: The AI model service interface utilizes specific parameter types to request text, object, or embedding generation.
Result interfaces capture the output of generation requests alongside completion data and usage statistics.
Streaming events provide granular updates during the execution of long-running generation tasks.
designDecisions: Usage of interface definitions to decouple provider implementation from client logic
Definition of central service tags to facilitate dependency injection
Categorization of outputs through union types for message parts and stream events
